items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Did you ever hear Oliver play? Oh, yeah, King Oliver. How did he work when you heard him? ... The time I heard King Oliver, he was playing the color dance at the Economy Hall.

ctx.x: Might have been. Was he the cornet player?

The trumpet player, yeah. Yeah, Albert. Well, he changed musicians a lot, huh? Oh, yeah, he changed musicians a lot. Did you ever hear Oliver play? Oh, yeah, King Oliver. How did he work when you heard him? Do you remember how he was playing? Where did he work at? Mm-hmm. The time I heard King Oliver, he was playing the color dance at the Economy Hall. What? Economy Hall. Then he used to play at the National Park sometimes. He'd be on third in the South Carolina. He used to have a big park there. Was that for…
You remember if that was, I suppose that would be the album system, the same as Barney played.
